style.styleTitle: Metallic Mirror Personalised Couples Penguin Christmas Bauble by No Ordinary Gift
style.toneOfVoice: A glass bauble for any couple, featuring a penguin couple made from mirror acrylic standing in front of a frosted acrylic moon. Each penguin is personalised and engraved with a name. There is space for 2 lines of personalised text engraved onto the moon, along with a scattering of stars that will be included as standard. The first line of text curves around the top of the moon, and below this is the second line of text. No text is included as standard, so your personalisation will be engraved exactly as entered. <br>The bauble measures approximately 10 x 10 cm.<br>most personalised items will be delivered within 7 days. Estimated delivery will be confirmed at the point of order. Please note that personalised items cannot be cancelled once your order is placed. Please do not include accents, special symbols, or emojis as some of our processes will not allow this. Please be aware – these items will be made especially for you, so they can only be returned if they are faulty, do not fit their description, or do not meet your instruction.
